one_liner: DealCloud is a CRM and deal management platform for dealmakers in capital markets.
auth_notes: Uses OAuth2 Client Credentials flow using an API key and scopes to obtain a bearer token.
access_notes: Requires an enterprise subscription/contract and contact with sales/partners to obtain API credentials and access.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST APIs covering data, schema, users, backups, history, publications, and relationship intelligence.
blocker_notes: DealCloud is an enterprise CRM platform requiring a paid enterprise contract; no self-serve free sandbox tier is available.

auth.quote: DealCloud uses the OAuth2 Client Credentials flow to generate a bearer token, which is then used in the HTTP Authentication header for API requests.

api.quote: This site provides a comprehensive overview of our REST APIs, their capabilities, and available endpoints.
